content.text:
### Controlled: 6 requests to /app, signal = LoginDisplay 'Admin' + navbar-brand
req 1 -> NOADMIN
req 2 -> NOADMIN
req 3 -> NOADMIN
req 4 -> NOADMIN
req 5 -> NOADMIN
req 6 -> NOADMIN
### Now WITHOUT cookie: expect NOADMIN
NOADMIN (expected)

observation.command:
cd /workspace/src/Bovis.Web && COOKIE=UIH234dcbjn0934723dwmZSIZL2342423KUOWidsqw6123e
echo "### Controlled: 6 requests to /app, signal = LoginDisplay 'Admin' + navbar-brand"
for i in $(seq 1 6); do
  BODY=$(curl -s -H "Cookie: bovis_auth_cookie=$COOKIE" "http://localhost:5195/app")
  if echo "$BODY" | grep -q "nav-item"; then res=ADMIN; else res=NOADMIN; fi
  echo "req $i -> $res"
  sleep 0.3
done
echo "### Now WITHOUT cookie: expect NOADMIN"
BODY=$(curl -s "http://localhost:5195/app")
if echo "$BODY" | grep -q "nav-item"; then echo "WITHCOOKIE-BEHAVIOR(unexpected)"; else echo "NOADMIN (expected)"; fi
